title: The Truth Seeker
subtitle: Reaching out, we are so close to the answer.

items.text: The Truth Seeker

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Apeiron, the Boundless, the beginning of all things.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Everything originates from it and returns to it.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Infinity has no start and no end. But nothing would come into existence if there's only infinity.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Look up there, Vertin.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Now, they are presenting in their true Forms.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: In their purest and newest Forms.
The cave is bright as daytime, as if it's ready for a grand orchestra performance.
37 stretches out her hands like a proud conductor.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Our world was born from the wounds on "infinity" when it's cut by "finity." The patterns of the cuttings are what we call mathematics.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Thus, the essences of numbers exist inside all beings, and the patterns of all numbers exist in all Matters.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: The length of a butterfly's wings and its body are in golden ratio, and plant leaves grow on their stems in the pattern of the Fibonacci spiral.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: This is the most primitive rhythm of "arcanum," and it is also the beginning of our extraordinary study.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: This is the essence.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: And how do I submit my proof?

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Close your eyes, Vertin.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Only when your eyes are closed will your mind open up.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Now, stay fully concentrated and recall the question you want to verify.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Only in the absolute contemplation can truth reveal itself to you.
Close my eyes
The body is tossed up and falls into the eternal silence.
Yet the soul is thrilled, celebrating its hard-earned liberty.
As it rises higher, it sees farther.
It transcends the eternal wheel of birth and rises beyond the continuously running wheel of time.
From the void to the first existence.
From 1 to 2, then to 3.
From points, to lines, then to planes.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The "Storm," the Emanation, the Storm Syndrome.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Where are they from?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Foundation, Manus Vindictae, Apeiron.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What roles do they play?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Why doesn't the "Storm" fall into the misty land?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What is the ingredient of "asymmetrical nuclide R" ...
All the clues from the past are gathering here.
Points make lines, lines make planes, and planes join into a net.
The huge net of mysteries.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: The world is a dark underground labyrinth.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: But pneuma can guide us to go beyond all things and reach the exit.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Vertin, can you see it?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... It's burning!
The stone bangle on the wrist becomes scalding again.
The tranquil kingdom of truth disappears, replaced with endless chaos.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What's going on?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Is somebody fighting with the Manus now?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What's happening outside the cave?

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Vertin, why are you straying? If the meditation goes beyond control, you will be thrown out of here!

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: This would be a foolish mistake! For Apeiron, this is ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ah!
Suddenly, a voice comes into the mind.
Like a strong wind blowing off the candle.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Alas! No man shall bravest the "Storm" and live.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Including thee.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Huh?!

items.speaker: The Manus Believer I
items.text: UUUGGGHHH!

items.speaker: The Manus Believer II
items.text: UUGHHHH!!
All the heavenly images have gone.
In the depths of the freezing cave, the Manus's pawns are violently knocking their heads against the walls.
By their feet, 37 is lying unconsciously, yet muttering incomprehensible words.
The sole stone statue is still in the cave, looking down upon them indifferently.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What happened? Were all those illusions?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: If it weren't for the heat of the stone bangle that wakes me up, would I go as crazy as they did?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This stone reminds me of the spinning wheel.
Luckily, the leather box is still here.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The collector of "asymmetrical nuclide R" ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: If the reagent turns gold after reacting with the fog here, that means ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The fog contains elements that can be immune to the "Storm."
A hint of gold forms in the glass tube.
This has never happened before.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The color changed faster than I thought.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The concentration of R is hundreds of times, no, thousands of times higher than in the Manus's masks.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: In other words, whoever owns this cave can produce the protective equipment of the "Storm" in big numbers.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Is that the reason why Arcana is here?!
37 rolls over in her sleep.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Oh, Mother ... Our model ... hasn't failed … hasn't failed …

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I need to take 37 out of here.

items.speaker: The Manus Believer III
items.text: UUUGGGHHH!

items.speaker: The Manus Believer IV
items.text: UUUGGGHHH!
More insane pawns are charging out from the shadows, blocking their way.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: So the Abraxases were people from the Manus.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The fog here can affect people's minds, like those around the lake in my suitcase.
Hold up my wrist
The stone bangle is incredibly heated.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Have the Manus found a way to launch attacks without being punished by the bangle?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Or, don't they care about the "price" they will be paying anymore?
The danger is close. One must act now.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I hope Regulus didn't throw my words to the wind.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I have to get rid of them first and go out to join the others!
TO BE CONTINUED…
